data.source: committed public Binance daily OHLCV fixtures (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT)
data.walk_forward: rolling scan at indices 250,270,290,310,330 with forward simulation from that bar open
data.note: No new dataset fetched for these hypotheses; no order book or options data exists in artifacts.

criteria.promotion: only if OOS net > no-trade and walk-forward majority positive; no relaxation

hypotheses.theory: Filtering cross-asset trend confirmation by a widening-spread/poor-volume proxy removes low-quality entries where 15 bps/side costs dominate.
hypotheses.baseline: prior cross-asset scan without microstructure filter
hypotheses.falsification: reject if OOS trades <2, OOS drawdown >25%, OOS net <= baseline, or walk-forward not majority positive

hypotheses.theory: Among cross-asset confirmed candidates, selecting the asset with lower realized-vol percentile improves risk-adjusted net return versus selecting by trend score.
hypotheses.baseline: selection by trend score only (prior scan)
hypotheses.falsification: reject if OOS trades <2, OOS drawdown >25%, OOS net <= baseline, or walk-forward not majority positive
